claims.claim: You cannot get bankruptcy through this service if you are already bankrupt.
claims.quote: (d) no bankruptcy order has been made in respect of any of the debts which are the subject of the application at the date of the determination.
claims.note: The Act bars an order only where a bankruptcy order has already been made for any of the debts in the application (or a petition is pending); it does not state a general exclusion for anyone already bankrupt.
